title: Rocky Road Chocolate Slab vs 1000 Cuts #satisfying #oddlysatisfying #asmr
description:
One rocky road chocolate slab, six rounds: 10 → 50 → 100 → 240 → 500 → 1,000 cuts. By the final round it's about 26.6 million cubes.
